title: Miami-based Cyclops, which sells an infrastructure platform that bundles crypto and stablecoin services to payments companies, raised a $20M Series A (Camila Grigera Naón/Fortune)
summary: Camila Grigera Naón / Fortune: Miami-based Cyclops, which sells an infrastructure platform that bundles crypto and stablecoin services to payments companies, raised a $20M Series A — The advent of stablecoins has made it possible to settle global transactions instantly, but many payment providers have yet to catch up …
